title.zh: 卷三 本紀第三: 太宗
title.raw: 卷三 本紀第三: 太宗 Volume 3 Annals 3: Taizong

sentences.zh: 太宗體元應運世德昭功哲惠仁聖文烈皇帝，諱晟，本諱吳乞買，世祖第四子，母曰翼簡皇后拏懶氏，太祖母弟也。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong, posthumous title Tiyuan Yingyun Shide Zhaogong Zhehui Rensheng Wenlie, taboo name Sheng, original taboo name Wuqimai, fourth son of Shizu; his mother was Empress Yijian of the Nalan clan, a cousin of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong—posthumously styled Embodying the Origin, Answering the Mandate, World Virtue, Illustrious Merit, Wise and Gracious, Benevolent and Sagely, Cultured and Ardent—was taboo-named Sheng, born Wuqimai, the fourth son of Shizu. His mother was Empress Yijian of the Nalan clan, a cousin of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 遼太康元年乙卯歲生。

translations.literal: He was born in the first year of Liao Taikang, the year yimao.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in the first year of Liao Taikang (the yimao year).

sentences.zh: 初爲穆宗養子。

translations.literal: At first he was the adopted son of Mukui.
translations.idiomatic: He was first raised as Mukui’s adopted son.

sentences.zh: 收國元年十月，命爲諳班勃極烈。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Shouguo, he was appointed an-ban boji lie.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Shouguo he was named an-ban boji lie—the chief heir’s seat.

sentences.zh: 太祖征伐，常居守。

translations.literal: When Taizu went on campaign, he regularly remained behind as regent.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Taizu took the field, he stayed behind to guard the realm.

sentences.zh: 天輔五年，賜詔曰：「汝惟朕之母弟，義均一體，是用汝貳我國政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianfu, an edict was granted, saying: “You alone are my younger brother by the same mother; in duty we are one body. Therefore I set you to assist in governing the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianfu an edict ran: “You are my uterine brother—one flesh with me—and I therefore place you second in the government of the realm.

sentences.zh: 凡軍事違者，閱實其罪，從宜處之。

translations.literal: Whoever violates military orders, examine and verify the crime and dispose as fit.
translations.idiomatic: Where military orders are broken, verify the offense and punish as you see fit.

sentences.zh: 其餘事無大小，一依本朝舊制。」

translations.literal: All other matters, great or small, follow entirely the old institutions of this dynasty.”
translations.idiomatic: All else, great or small, shall follow our dynasty’s established ways.”

sentences.zh: 天輔七年六月，太祖次鴛鴦濼，有疾。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year of Tianfu, Taizu halted at Yuanyang Marsh and fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year of Tianfu Taizu camped at Yuanyang Marsh and took ill.

sentences.zh: 至斡獨山驛，召赴行在。

translations.literal: Reaching Wadu Shan post, he was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: At Wadu Shan post he was called to the emperor’s traveling camp.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「今遼主盡喪其師，奔于夏國。

translations.literal: An edict said: “Now the Liao ruler has lost his armies entirely and fled to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ran: “The Liao sovereign has lost his whole army and fled into Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 遼官特列、遙設等劫其子雅里而立之，已留宗翰等措畫。

translations.literal: Liao officials Telie, Yaoshe, and others seized his son Yali and set him up as ruler; I have left Zonghan and others to manage this.
translations.idiomatic: Liao ministers Telie, Yaoshe, and others have seized his son Yali and made him ruler; I have left Zonghan and others to deal with it.

sentences.zh: 朕親巡已久，功亦大就，所獲州部，政須綏撫，是用還都。

translations.literal: I have campaigned in person for a long time and the achievement is largely complete; the prefectures we have taken must now be pacified—therefore I return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: My own campaign has run long and the work is nearly done; the districts we have won need settling—so I turn homeward.

sentences.zh: 八月中旬，可至春州，汝率內戚迎我，若至豹子崖尤善。

translations.literal: By mid-eighth month you may reach Chunzhou; lead the inner kin to meet me—it would be best if you came as far as Baozi Cliff.”
translations.idiomatic: By mid-eighth month you should reach Chunzhou. Bring the inner kin to meet me; coming on to Baozi Cliff would be ideal.”

sentences.zh: 」八月乙未，會于渾河北。

translations.literal: On yimao in the eighth month they met north of the Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the eighth month they joined north of the Hun River.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太祖崩。

translations.literal: On wushen, Taizu died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Taizu died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，葬太祖于宮城西。

translations.literal: On yimao in the ninth month Taizu was buried west of the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the ninth month Taizu was buried west of the palace city.

sentences.zh: 國論勃極烈杲、鄆王昂、宗峻、宗幹率宗親百宮請正帝位，不許，固請，亦不許。

translations.literal: Guo, guolun boji lie, Prince of Yun Ang, Zongjun, and Zonggan led the imperial kin and the hundred officials to ask that he take the throne; he did not consent; they pressed again and again, and still he did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: Guo the guolun boji lie, Ang prince of Yun, Zongjun, and Zonggan led kinsmen and the full court to enthrone him; he refused. They pressed again and again; he still refused.

sentences.zh: 宗幹率諸弟以赭袍被體，置璽懷中。

translations.literal: Zonggan led the younger brothers to drape the crimson robe on his body and place the seal in his bosom.
translations.idiomatic: Zonggan and the younger princes threw the crimson robe over him and thrust the seal into his breast.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On bingchen he ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he took the throne.

sentences.zh: 己未，告祀天地。

translations.literal: On jiwei he announced sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he offered sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大赦中外。

translations.literal: On bingyin a great amnesty was proclaimed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he proclaimed a general amnesty at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 改天輔七年爲天會元年。

translations.literal: The seventh year of Tianfu was changed to the first year of Tianhui.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh year of Tianfu was renamed the first year of Tianhui.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，發春州粟，賑降人之徙于上京者。

translations.literal: On guiyou grain from Chunzhou was released to relieve surrendered people relocated to Shangjing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou grain from Chunzhou was issued to feed surrendered peoples moved to Shangjing.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔諸猛安賦米，給戶口在內地匱乏者。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict ordered all meng’an to levy rice and supply households in the interior whose registers were destitute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict told every meng’an to levy rice for households registered in the interior who lacked food.

sentences.zh: 南路軍帥闍母，敗張覺于樓峰口。

translations.literal: Zhamu, southern-route army commander, defeated Zhang Jue at Loufeng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Zhamu, commander of the southern route army, defeated Zhang Jue at Loufeng Pass.

sentences.zh: 十月壬辰，詔以空名宣頭百道給西南、西北兩路都統宗翰，曰：「今寄爾以方面，如當遷授必待奏請，恐致稽滯，其以便宜從事。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict granted a hundred blank commission patents to Zonghan, supreme commander of the southwest and northwest routes, saying: “Now I entrust you with a whole region; if every promotion must await memorial and reply, delay may follow—act at your discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict gave Zonghan, supreme commander of the southwest and northwest routes, a hundred blank commission patents: “You hold a whole front. Waiting on court for every appointment will only slow you—use your own judgment.

sentences.zh: 」己亥，上京慶元寺僧獻佛骨，卻之。

translations.literal: On jihai a monk of Qingyuan Temple in Shangjing presented Buddha’s relics; they were declined.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai a monk of Shangjing’s Qingyuan Temple offered Buddha’s relics; the gift was refused.

sentences.zh: 闍母及張覺戰于兔耳山，闍母敗績。

translations.literal: Zhamu and Zhang Jue fought at Tu’er Mountain; Zhamu was badly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Zhamu met Zhang Jue at Tu’er Mountain and suffered a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，命宗望問闍母罪，以其兵討張覺。

translations.literal: On renzi in the eleventh month Zongwang was ordered to investigate Zhamu’s offense and take his troops to attack Zhang Jue.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the eleventh month Zongwang was charged to try Zhamu’s fault and lead his army against Zhang Jue.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，復以空名宣頭及銀牌給上京路軍帥實古乃、婆盧火等。

translations.literal: On renxu blank commission patents and silver tallies were again given to Shigunai, Poluhuo, and other commanders of the Shangjing route.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu blank patents and silver tallies were issued again to Shigunai, Poluhuo, and other Shangjing-route commanders.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，宗望以闍母軍發廣寧，下瀕海諸郡縣。

translations.literal: On guihai Zongwang marched from Guangning with Zhamu’s army and reduced the coastal prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zongwang left Guangning with Zhamu’s force and overran the seaboard districts.

sentences.zh: 詔諭南京，割武、朔二州入于宋。

translations.literal: An edict informed the Southern Capital that Wu and Shuo prefectures were ceded to Song.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the Southern Capital to hand Wu and Shuo prefectures to Song.

sentences.zh: 婁室破朔州西山，擒其帥趙公直。

translations.literal: Loushi broke the western hills of Shuo Prefecture and captured its commander Zhao Gongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Loushi routed the western hills of Shuo Prefecture and took its commander Zhao Gongzhi.

sentences.zh: 勃堇斡魯別及勃剌速破走乙室白答于歸化。

translations.literal: Beljen Woluobe and Bolasu routed Yishi Baida at Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: The beljen Woluobe and Bolasu drove off Yishi Baida at Guihua.

sentences.zh: 己巳，徙遷、潤、來、顯四州之民于瀋州。

translations.literal: On jisi the people of Qian, Run, Lai, and Xian prefectures were moved to Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the populace of Qian, Run, Lai, and Xian prefectures was relocated to Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，宗望及張覺戰于南京東，大敗之。

translations.literal: On gengwu Zongwang fought Zhang Jue east of the Southern Capital and routed him utterly.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zongwang met Zhang Jue east of the Southern Capital and broke him completely.

sentences.zh: 張覺奔宋，城中人執其父及二子以獻，戮之軍中。

translations.literal: Zhang Jue fled to Song; men in the city seized his father and two sons and presented them; they were executed in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jue fled into Song, but the townspeople seized his father and two sons and handed them over; all three were put to death in camp.

sentences.zh: 壬申，張忠嗣、張敦固以南京降，遣使與張敦固入諭城中，復殺其使者以叛。

translations.literal: On renshen Zhang Zhongsi and Zhang Dungu surrendered the Southern Capital; envoys were sent with Zhang Dungu to persuade the city, but the city again killed the envoys and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Zhang Zhongsi and Zhang Dungu surrendered the Southern Capital and sent Zhang Dungu in with envoys to win over the town; the town killed the envoys and rose again.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔女直人，先有附于遼，今復虜獲者，悉從其所欲居而復之。

translations.literal: On jimao an edict said: “Among Jurchen who formerly submitted to Liao and are now taken captive again, let each dwell where he wishes and restore him.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict ran: “Jurchen who once followed Liao and are captured again may live where they choose and be restored.

sentences.zh: 其奴婢部曲，昔雖逃背，今能復歸者，並聽爲民。

translations.literal: Their slaves, maidservants, and retainers—though they once fled—if they can return now, are all permitted to become commoners.”
translations.idiomatic: Slaves, bondwomen, and household troops who fled but come back may all be registered as free subjects.”

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，蠲民間貸息。

translations.literal: On xinsi in the twelfth month private loan interest was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the twelfth month interest on private loans was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 詔以咸州以南，蘇、復州以北，年穀不登，其應輸南京軍糧免之。

translations.literal: An edict said: south of Xianzhou and north of Su and Fu prefectures, where the year’s grain did not ripen, grain due as military rations to the Southern Capital was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted Southern Capital military grain levies from south of Xianzhou to north of Su and Fu wherever the harvest failed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔曰：「此聞民間乏食，至有鬻其子者，其聽以丁力等者贖之。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict said: “We hear that among the people food is scarce, so that some even sell their children; let them redeem them with labor of equal value.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict ran: “We hear the people lack food—some have sold their children. Let kin redeem them with labor of equal worth.

sentences.zh: 」是日，以國論勃極烈杲爲諳班勃極烈，宗幹爲國論勃極烈。

translations.literal: That day Guo, guolun boji lie, was made an-ban boji lie, and Zonggan was made guolun boji lie.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Guo the guolun boji lie was raised to an-ban boji lie, and Zonggan was named guolun boji lie.

sentences.zh: 遣勃堇李靖如宋告哀。

translations.literal: Beljen Li Jing was sent to Song to announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The beljen Li Jing was dispatched to Song with word of Taizu’s death.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚戌朔，以謾都訶爲阿舍勃極烈，參議國政。

translations.literal: On gengxu, New Year’s Day of the first month in the second year, Manduhe was made a-she boji lie to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, New Year’s Day of the second year, Manduhe was appointed a-she boji lie to counsel on government.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命賞宗望及將士克南京之功，赦闍母罪。

translations.literal: On renzi rewards were ordered for Zongwang and the officers who took the Southern Capital, and Zhamu’s offense was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Zongwang and the troops who seized the Southern Capital were rewarded, and Zhamu’s crimes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以空名宣頭五十、銀牌十給宗望。

translations.literal: On jiayin fifty blank commission patents and ten silver tallies were given to Zongwang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zongwang received fifty blank patents and ten silver tallies.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔孛堇完顏阿實賚曰：「先帝以同姓之人有自育及典質其身者，命官爲贖。

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict to beljen Wanyan Ashiben said: “The late emperor, seeing men of the same surname who had sold or pawned themselves, ordered officials to redeem them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict told the beljen Wanyan Ashiben: “The late sovereign found clansmen who had sold or pawned their persons and ordered officials to buy them back.

sentences.zh: 今聞尚有未復者，其悉閱贖之。

translations.literal: We now hear that some have still not been restored; review all cases and redeem them.
translations.idiomatic: We now hear that some have still not been restored—review every case and redeem them.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以東京比歲不登，詔減田租、市租之半。

translations.literal: ” On guihai, because the Eastern Capital had poor harvests year after year, an edict halved field rent and market tax.
translations.idiomatic: ” On guihai, with the Eastern Capital failing harvest after harvest, an edict cut field and market taxes by half.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，西南、西北兩路都統宗翰、宗望請勿割山西郡縣與宋，上曰：「是違先帝之命也，其速與之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Zonghan and Zongwang, commanders-in-chief of the southwest and northwest routes, asked that Shanxi prefectures and counties not be ceded to Song. The Emperor said: “That would violate the late emperor’s command—cede them at once.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Zonghan and Zongwang, commanders-in-chief of the southwest and northwest routes, urged that Shanxi prefectures and counties not be given to Song. The emperor said, “That would defy the late sovereign’s order—hand them over at once.

sentences.zh: 」夏國奉表稱籓，以下寨以北，陰山以南、乙室耶剌部吐祿濼西之地與之。

translations.literal: ” Western Xia submitted a memorial declaring vassalage; the lands north of Xiashai, south of Yinshan, and west of the Yishiyeilie tribe’s Tulü Marsh were granted to them.
translations.idiomatic: ” Western Xia sent a memorial submitting as vassal; Jin granted them territory north of Xiashai, south of Yinshan, and west of the Yishiyeilie tribe’s Tulü Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丙子，貽宋書，索俘虜叛亡。

translations.literal: On bingzi, a letter was sent to Song demanding return of captives and defectors.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Jin sent Song a letter demanding captives and defectors be returned.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，始自京師至南京每五十里置驛。

translations.literal: On dingchou, relay stations were first established every fifty li from the capital to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou relay posts were first set up every fifty li from the capital to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔有盜發遼諸陵者，罪死。

translations.literal: In the second month, an edict: anyone who robs Liao imperial tombs shall be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month an edict ruled that grave-robbers of Liao imperial tombs would be executed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔命給宗翰馬七百匹、田種千石、米七千石，以賑新附之民。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict ordered seven hundred horses, a thousand shi of seed grain, and seven thousand shi of rice given to Zonghan to relieve the newly submitted people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict gave Zonghan seven hundred horses, a thousand shi of seed, and seven thousand shi of rice to relieve newly submitted subjects.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命徙移懶路都勃堇完顏忠于蘇瀕水。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Yilan Route chief bojin Wanyan Zhong was ordered moved to the Supin River.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wanyan Zhong, chief bojin of the Yilan Route, was ordered relocated to the Supin River.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔諭南京官僚，小大之事，必關白軍帥，無得專達朝廷。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict told Southern Capital officials that on matters large and small they must inform the army commander-in-chief and might not report directly to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict instructed Southern Capital officials that all business, great or small, had to go through the army commander-in-chief—no direct reports to court.

sentences.zh: 丙午，宗翰乞濟師，詔有司選精兵五千給之。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Zonghan asked for reinforcements; an edict ordered officials to select five thousand elite troops and send them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zonghan requested reinforcements; an edict had the ministries choose five thousand picked troops and dispatch them.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命宗望，凡南京留守及諸闕員，可選勳賢有人望者就注擬之，具姓名官階以聞。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Zongwang was ordered: for the Southern Capital defender and all vacant posts, choose meritorious men of standing, appoint them on the spot, and report names and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zongwang was told that for the Southern Capital garrison chief and every vacancy he should name men of merit and reputation, appoint them forthwith, and report names and ranks.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉朔，命宗望以宋歲幣銀絹分賜將士之有功者。

translations.literal: On the new moon yiyou in the third month, Zongwang was ordered to distribute Song’s annual tribute of silver and silk among officers and soldiers who had earned merit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the third month’s new moon, Zongwang was ordered to divide Song’s annual silver and silk tribute among meritorious officers and troops.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，叛人活孛帶降，詔釋之。

translations.literal: On gengxu the rebel Huo Bodai surrendered; an edict pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the rebel Huo Bodai submitted; an edict released him.

sentences.zh: 宗望請選良吏招撫遷、潤、來、顯之民保山寨者，從之。

translations.literal: Zongwang asked to select capable officials to win over people holding mountain forts in Qian, Run, Lai, and Xian; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang asked to send good officials to win over people in mountain strongholds in Qian, Run, Lai, and Xian; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 己未，宗望以南京反覆，凡攻取之行，乞與知樞密院事劉彥宗裁決之。

translations.literal: On jiwei, because the Southern Capital was unstable, Zongwang asked that all offensive operations be decided with Liu Yanzong, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, with the Southern Capital still unsettled, Zongwang asked that every attack be decided jointly with Liu Yanzong, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 劉公胄、王永福棄家逾城來降，以公胄爲廣甯尹，永福爲奉先軍節度使。

translations.literal: Liu Gongzhou and Wang Yongfu abandoned their families and crossed the wall to surrender; Gongzhou was made Guangning intendant and Yongfu military commissioner of the Fengxian army.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gongzhou and Wang Yongfu left their households and climbed the wall to defect; Gongzhou became intendant of Guangning and Yongfu military commissioner of Fengxian.

sentences.zh: 辛未，夏國王李乾順遣使上誓表。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Western Xia king Li Qianshun sent envoys presenting the oath memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei King Li Qianshun of Western Xia sent envoys with the oath memorial.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊寅朔，賜夏國誓詔。

translations.literal: On the intercalary month’s new moon wuyin, the oath edict was bestowed on Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, new moon of the intercalary month, Western Xia received the oath edict.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命置驛上京、春、泰之間。

translations.literal: On xinsi, relay stations were ordered established between Shangjing, Chun, and Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the court ordered relay posts between Shangjing, Chun, and Tai.

sentences.zh: 己丑，烏虎里、迪烈底兩部來降。

translations.literal: On jichou the Wuhuli and Dilieidi tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Wuhuli and Dilieidi tribes came over.

sentences.zh: 丙午，既許割山西諸鎮與宋，以宗翰言罷之。

translations.literal: On bingwu, having already agreed to cede the Shanxi garrisons to Song, the cession was cancelled on Zonghan’s advice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, though Shanxi garrisons had been promised to Song, Zonghan’s counsel caused the cession to be called off.

sentences.zh: 是月，斜野襲遙輦昭古牙，走之，獲其妻孥群從及豪族。

translations.literal: That month Xieye raided the Yaolian Zhaoguya, put him to flight, and seized his wife, children, kin, and leading families.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xieye struck Yaolian Zhaoguya, drove him off, and took his wife, children, kinsmen, and notables.

sentences.zh: 勃堇渾啜等破奚七崖而撫其民人。

translations.literal: Bojin Hunchuo and others defeated the Xi at Qiya and pacified the people.
translations.idiomatic: Bojin Hunchuo and others broke the Xi at Qiya and settled the populace.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑朔，上京軍帥實古乃以所獲印綬二十二及銀牌來上。

translations.literal: On the new moon dingchou in the fifth month, the Shangjing army commander Shigu’nai presented twenty-two captured seals and cords and silver tablets.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the fifth month’s new moon, Shangjing army commander Shigu’nai presented twenty-two captured seals and cords and silver tablets.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔曰：「新降之民，訴訟者衆，今方農時，或失田業，可俟農隙聽決。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict said: “Among the newly submitted people lawsuits are many; now is planting season and fields may be lost—hear cases after the agricultural slack.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei an edict ran: “New subjects are suing in great numbers; it is planting season and men may lose their fields—adjourn hearings until the farming lull.

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，婆速路猛安僕盧古以贓罷，以謀克習泥烈代之。

translations.literal: ” On dinghai, the Basu Route meng’an Pulugu was dismissed for corruption; the mouke Xinilie replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: ” On dinghai Pulugu, meng’an of the Basu Route, was removed for graft; the mouke Xinilie took his place.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，曷懶路軍帥完顏忽剌古等言：「往者歲捕海狗、海東青、鴉、鶻于高麗之境，近以二舟往，彼乃以戰艦十四要而擊之，盡殺二舟之人，奮其兵杖。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Yilan Route army commander Wanyan Hulagu and others reported: “In former years we annually took sea dogs, sea hawks, crows, and falcons in Goryeo waters; recently two boats went, and they met them with fourteen warships, killed everyone on both boats, and seized their arms.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wanyan Hulagu, army commander of the Yilan Route, and others reported: “We used to hunt sea dogs, sea hawks, crows, and falcons each year in Goryeo waters. Lately we sent two boats; they intercepted with fourteen warships, killed every man on both boats, and took our weapons.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「以小故起戰爭，甚非所宜。

translations.literal: ” The Emperor said: “To start a war over a small matter is very ill-advised.
translations.idiomatic: ” The emperor said, “To go to war over a trifle is wholly unsuitable.

sentences.zh: 今後非奉命，毋輒往。

translations.literal: Hereafter, unless ordered, do not go on your own.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth you are not to go unless commanded.

sentences.zh: 闍母克南京，殺都統張敦固。

translations.literal: Shemu took the Southern Capital and killed the commander Zhang Dungu.
translations.idiomatic: Shemu captured the Southern Capital and killed Commander Zhang Dungu.

sentences.zh: 七月壬午，皇子宗峻薨。

translations.literal: On renwu in the seventh month, Prince Zongjun died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the seventh month Prince Zongjun died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禁外方使介冗從多者。

translations.literal: On bingxu, envoys from abroad with excessive attendants were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the court barred foreign envoys from bringing large retinues.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，鶻實答言：「高麗約吾叛亡，增其邊備，必有異圖。

translations.literal: On renchen, Hesuda reported: “Goryeo harbors our defectors and has strengthened its border defenses—surely they plot something.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Hesuda reported: “Goryeo shelters our deserters and has reinforced its frontier—they must intend something.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「納我叛亡而弗歸，其曲在彼。

translations.literal: ” An edict said: “If they harbor our defectors and do not return them, the fault lies with them.
translations.idiomatic: ” An edict said: “If they keep our deserters and refuse to send them back, the wrong is theirs.

sentences.zh: 凡有通問，毋違常式。

translations.literal: In all communications, do not depart from regular protocol.
translations.idiomatic: In all exchanges, observe the usual forms.

sentences.zh: 或來侵略，整爾行列，與之從事。

translations.literal: If they invade, array your ranks and engage them.
translations.idiomatic: If they attack, form your lines and fight them.

sentences.zh: 敢先犯彼，雖捷必罰。

translations.literal: Whoever strikes them first, though victorious, will be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever strikes first, though he wins, will be punished.

sentences.zh: 」乙未，以烏虎部及諸營叛，以昊勃極烈昱等討平之。

translations.literal: ” On yiwei, because the Wuhu tribe and several camps rebelled, Grand Preceptor Yu and others were sent to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: ” On yiwei the Wuhu tribe and several camps rose; Grand Preceptor Yu and others were sent to put them down.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳朔，以孛堇烏爪乃等爲賀宋生辰使。

translations.literal: On the new moon yisi in the eighth month, Wuzuainai and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the eighth month’s new moon, Wuzuainai and others were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，撒離改部猛安雛思以贓罷，以奚金家奴代之。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Saliega Route meng’an Chusi was dismissed for corruption; the Xi Jianu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Chusi, meng’an of the Saliega Route, was removed for graft; Xi Jianu replaced him.

sentences.zh: 六部都統撻懶擊走昭古牙，殺其隊將曷魯燥、白撒曷等。

translations.literal: Talan, commander-in-chief of the Six Departments, routed Zhaoguya and killed his squad leaders Helüzao, Baisaha, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Talan, Six Departments commander-in-chief, drove off Zhaoguya and killed squad leaders Helüzao, Baisaha, and others.

sentences.zh: 又破降駱駝山、金源、興中諸軍，詔增給銀牌十。

translations.literal: He also defeated and received the surrender of the armies at Luotuo Mountain, Jinyuan, and Xingzhong; an edict added ten silver tablets.
translations.idiomatic: He also broke and received the armies of Luotuo Mountain, Jinyuan, and Xingzhong; an edict granted ten more silver tablets.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰朔，夏國遣使謝誓詔。

translations.literal: On the new moon jiachen in the tenth month, Western Xia sent envoys to thank the court for the oath edict.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the tenth month’s new moon, Western Xia sent envoys to thank Jin for the oath edict.

sentences.zh: 戊午，天清節，宋、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Tianqing Festival, Song and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Tianqing Festival, Song and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔發甯江州粟，賑泰州民被秋潦者。

translations.literal: On jiazi, an edict ordered grain released from Ningjiang Prefecture to relieve Taizhou people afflicted by autumn floods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict released grain from Ningjiang Prefecture to aid Taizhou subjects stricken by autumn flooding.

sentences.zh: 遙輦昭古牙率衆來降。

translations.literal: The Yaolian Zhaoguya led his people to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Yaolian Zhaoguya led his followers in submission.

sentences.zh: 興中府降。

translations.literal: Xingzhong Prefecture surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhong Prefecture submitted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔有司運米五萬石于廣寧，以給南京、潤州戍卒。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict ordered officials to transport fifty thousand shi of rice to Guangning to supply garrison troops at the Southern Capital and Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict ordered fifty thousand shi of rice moved to Guangning for garrisons at the Southern Capital and Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 命南路軍帥闍母，以甲士千人益合蘇館路孛堇完顏阿實賚，以備高麗。

translations.literal: The southern route army commander Shemu was ordered to add a thousand armored men to Heshuguan Route commander Wanyan Ashizhai against Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Shemu, southern route army commander, was told to reinforce Heshuguan Route commander Wanyan Ashizhai with a thousand armored troops against Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，西南、西北兩路權都統斡魯言：「遼祥穩撻不野來奔，言耶律大石自稱爲王，置南北官屬，有戰馬萬匹。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Wolu, acting commander-in-chief of the southwest and northwest routes, reported: “The Liao xiangwen Tabuye came in flight and said Yelü Dashi has proclaimed himself king, set up southern and northern official staffs, and has ten thousand war horses.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wolu, acting commander-in-chief of the southwest and northwest routes, reported that Liao xiangwen Tabuye had fled to Jin and said Yelü Dashi had taken the title of king, appointed southern and northern ministries, and mustered ten thousand war horses.

sentences.zh: 遼主從者不過四千戶，有步騎萬餘，欲趨天德，駐余都穀。

translations.literal: The Liao emperor’s following is no more than four thousand households; he has over ten thousand infantry and cavalry and wishes to hurry to Tiande, encamped at Yudu Valley.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao sovereign’s train counted fewer than four thousand households; he still had more than ten thousand foot and horse and meant to press toward Tiande, his camp at Yudu Valley.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「追襲遼主，必酌事宜。

translations.literal: ” An edict said: “In pursuing the Liao emperor, you must weigh circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: ” An edict ran, “In chasing the Liao emperor, weigh every circumstance.

sentences.zh: 其討大石，則俟報下。」

translations.literal: As for campaigning against Dashi, await memorial and orders from below.”
translations.idiomatic: As for moving against Dashi, hold until word comes from court.”

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，闍母下宜州，拔杈丫山，殺節度使韓慶民。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on guiwei, Shemu took Yizhou, captured Chaya Mountain, and killed Military Commissioner Han Qingmin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, Shemu descended on Yizhou, seized Chaya Mountain, and killed Military Commissioner Han Qingmin.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔以米五萬石給撻懶、實古乃。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict gave fifty thousand shi of rice to Talan and Shigunai.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict allotted fifty thousand shi of rice to Talan and Shigunai.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，以孛堇高居慶等爲賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on wushen, Chief bojin Gao Juqing and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen, Chief bojin Gao Juqing and others were appointed envoys to congratulate Song at the New Year.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，婁室獲遼主于余睹穀，丁卯，以厖葛城地分授所徙烏虎里、迪烈底二部及契丹民。

translations.literal: In the second month on renxu, Wushu captured the Liao emperor at Yudu Valley; on dingmao lands at Pangge City were allotted to the relocated Wuhuli and Dilieidi tribes and Khitan people.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu, Wushu took the Liao emperor at Yudu Valley; on dingmao the lands of Pangge City were parceled out among the relocated Wuhuli and Dilieidi tribes and the Khitan people.

sentences.zh: 四月壬寅朔，詔以遼主赴京師。

translations.literal: On the new moon renyin in the fourth month, an edict ordered the Liao emperor brought to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the fourth month’s new moon, an edict ordered the Liao emperor sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，南路軍帥察剌以罪罷。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Southern Route army commander Chala was dismissed for crime.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Chala, Southern Route army commander, was removed for offenses.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，蕭八斤獲遼玉寶來獻。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jichou, Xiao Bajin obtained Liao jade treasures and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jichou, Xiao Bajin seized Liao jade regalia and offered them up.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，以獲遼主，遣李用和等充告慶使如宋。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on gengshen, because the Liao emperor had been captured, Li Yonghe and others were sent as victory-announcement envoys to Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, with the Liao emperor taken, Li Yonghe and others were dispatched to Song as envoys bearing the news of triumph.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，禁內外官、宗室毋私役百姓。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on renshen, officials inside and outside court and the imperial clan were forbidden to privately press commoners for labor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renshen, an order forbade court officials and imperial kin, within and without the palace, to press commoners into private service.

sentences.zh: 己卯，南京帥以錦州野蠶成繭，奉其絲綿來獻，命賞其長吏。

translations.literal: On jimao the Southern Capital commander reported that wild silkworms in Jinzhou had formed cocoons; he presented the silk floss and was ordered to reward the district chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Southern Capital commander reported wild silkworms in Jinzhou had spun cocoons; he sent up the floss and silk and was told to reward the local chief.

sentences.zh: 詔權勢之家毋買貧民爲奴。

translations.literal: An edict forbade powerful families from buying poor people as slaves.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred great houses from buying the poor as slaves.

sentences.zh: 其脅買者一人償十五人，詐買者一人償二人，皆杖一百。

translations.literal: Coercive buyers must restore fifteen persons for one; fraudulent buyers two for one—all receive a hundred strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever coerced a purchase must free fifteen for one seized; whoever defrauded, two for one—each punished with a hundred blows.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔南京括官豪牧馬，以等第取之，分給諸軍。

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict ordered the Southern Capital to register official and magnate herds, take horses by grade, and distribute them among the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen an edict had the Southern Capital inventory horses kept by officials and magnates, levy them by grade, and issue them to the armies.

sentences.zh: 以耶律固等爲宋報謝使。

translations.literal: Yelü Gu and others were made envoys to Song in return thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Gu and others were appointed envoys to Song in thanks for their embassy.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，斡魯以遼主至京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on guimao, Wolu brought the Liao emperor to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guimao, Wolu escorted the Liao emperor into the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，告于太祖廟。

translations.literal: On jiachen report was made at Taizu’s temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the capture was announced at Taizu’s temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遼主延禧入見，降封海濱王。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Liao emperor Yanshi entered audience and was demoted and enfeoffed as Prince of the Sea Shore.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Liao emperor Yanshi was received in audience, then demoted and enfeoffed as Prince of the Sea Shore.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔有司揀閱善射勇健之士以備宋。

translations.literal: On renzi an edict ordered the ministries to review men skilled in archery and bold for use against Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict told the ministries to sort out keen archers and stout fighters against Song.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，廣寧府獻嘉禾。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on renwu, Guangning Prefecture presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, Guangning Prefecture offered up auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，保州路都孛堇加古撒曷有罪伏誅，以孛堇徒單烏烈代之。

translations.literal: On guisi the Baozhou Route chief bojin Jagusaha was executed for crime; Chief bojin Tudan Wulie replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Jagusaha, chief bojin of the Baozhou Route, was put to death for his crimes; Chief bojin Tudan Wulie took his place.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰，詔諸將伐宋。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on jiachen, an edict ordered the generals to attack Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiachen, an edict sent the generals against Song.

sentences.zh: 以諳班勃極烈杲兼領都元帥，移賚勃極烈宗翰兼左副元帥先鋒，經略使完顏希尹爲元帥右監軍，左金吾上將軍耶律余睹爲元帥右都臨，自西京入太原。

translations.literal: Gao the an-ban boji lie concurrently held supreme commander; Zonghan the yilasin boji lie concurrently held left deputy commander and vanguard; Commissioner Pacifying Wanyan Xiyin was right army supervisor of the commander; Left Golden Crow Upper General Yelü Yudu was right army inspector—they were to enter Taiyuan from the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Gao the an-ban boji lie took the supreme command; Zonghan the yilasin boji lie served as left deputy commander and vanguard; Pacification Commissioner Wanyan Xiyin was right army supervisor; Left Golden Crow Upper General Yelü Yudu was right army inspector—the western column would march from the Western Capital on Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 六部路軍帥撻懶爲六部路都統，斜也副之，宗望爲南京路都統，闍母副之，知樞密院事劉彥宗兼領漢軍都統，自南京入燕山。

translations.literal: Talan, Six Departments Route army commander, was Six Departments Route commander-in-chief with Xieye as deputy; Zongwang was Nanjing Route commander-in-chief with Shemu as deputy; Privy Council Affairs Commissioner Liu Yanzong concurrently held Han-army commander-in-chief—they were to enter Yanshan from the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Talan, Six Departments Route army commander, became route commander-in-chief with Xieye as his deputy; Zongwang commanded the Nanjing Route with Shemu second to him; Privy Council Commissioner Liu Yanzong also headed the Han armies—the southern column would drive from the Southern Capital into Yanshan.

sentences.zh: 詔建太祖廟于西京。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Taizu’s temple built at the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded a temple to Taizu be raised at the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 召耶魯赴京師教授女直字。

translations.literal: Yelu was summoned to the capital to teach Jurchen script.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu was called to court to instruct the court in Jurchen writing.

sentences.zh: 戊申，有司言權南路軍帥鶻實荅官吏貪縱，詔鞫之。

translations.literal: On wushen the ministries reported that acting Southern Route army commander Hesuda’s officers were greedy and lax; an edict ordered investigation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the ministries charged that officers under acting Southern Route commander Hesuda were corrupt and indulgent; an edict ordered them tried.

sentences.zh: 壬子，天清節，宋、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On renzi, the Tianqing Festival, Song and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Tianqing Festival, Song and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以闍母爲南京路都統，埽喝副之，宗望爲闍母、劉彥宗兩軍監戰。

translations.literal: On dingsi Shemu was made Nanjing Route commander-in-chief with Saohe as deputy; Zongwang supervised combat for Shemu’s and Liu Yanzong’s armies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Shemu was named Nanjing Route commander-in-chief with Saohe as deputy, and Zongwang was set to oversee the fighting of Shemu’s and Liu Yanzong’s forces.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔曰：「今大有年，無儲蓄則何以備饑饉，其令牛一具賦粟一石，每謀克爲一廩貯之。

translations.literal: On renxu an edict said: “This is a year of great harvest; without stores how shall we meet famine? Order one shi of grain levied per plow-team, and let each mouke keep one granary.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict ran: “The harvest is abundant; without stores how will we endure famine? Levy one shi of grain for each plow-team, and let every mouke maintain a granary.

sentences.zh: 」宋易州戍將韓民毅以軍降，處之蔚州。

translations.literal: ” Song Yizhou garrison commander Han Minyi surrendered with his army; they were settled at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: ” Han Minyi, Song commander of the Yizhou garrison, came over with his troops and was posted at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，以降封遼主爲海濱王詔中外。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on gengchen an edict informed inside and outside court of demoting and enfeoffing the Liao emperor as Prince of the Sea Shore.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengchen, an edict announced to the realm that the Liao emperor had been demoted and made Prince of the Sea Shore.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，南路軍帥司請禁契丹、奚、漢人挾兵器，詔勿禁。

translations.literal: On xinmao the Southern Route army command requested forbidding Khitan, Xi, and Han from carrying weapons; an edict said do not forbid.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Southern Route army staff asked to bar Khitan, Xi, and Han from bearing arms; an edict refused the ban.

sentences.zh: 以張忠嗣權簽南京中書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhongsi was appointed acting signer of Nanjing Joint Secretariat-Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhongsi was named acting signer of the Nanjing Secretariat-Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，宗翰下朔州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on gengzi Zonghan took Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengzi, Zonghan reduced Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宗望諸軍及宋郭藥師、張企徽、劉舜仁戰于白河。

translations.literal: On jiachen Zongwang’s armies and Song’s Guo Yaoshi, Zhang Qihui, and Liu Shunren fought at the White River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zongwang’s host met Song forces under Guo Yaoshi, Zhang Qihui, and Liu Shunren at the White River.

sentences.zh: 大破之。

translations.literal: They routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: Jin broke them completely.

sentences.zh: 蒲莧敗宋兵于古北口。

translations.literal: Puxian defeated Song troops at Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: Puxian shattered Song troops at Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，郭藥師降，燕山州縣悉平。

translations.literal: On bingwu Guo Yaoshi surrendered; all Yanshan prefectures and counties were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Guo Yaoshi submitted; every district of Yanshan was brought to order.

sentences.zh: 戊申，宗翰克代州。

translations.literal: On wushen Zonghan took Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zonghan seized Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，中山降。

translations.literal: On yimao Zhongshan submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhongshan came over.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，宗望破宋兵五千于真定。

translations.literal: On bingchen Zongwang broke five thousand Song troops at Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Zongwang crushed five thousand Song soldiers at Zhending.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宗翰圍太原。

translations.literal: On wuwu Zonghan besieged Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Zonghan invested Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 耶律余睹破宋河東、陝西援兵于汾河北。

translations.literal: Yelü Yudu routed Song relief armies from Hedong and Shaanxi north of the Fen River.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Yudu destroyed Song reinforcements from Hedong and Shaanxi north of the Fen.

sentences.zh: 甲子，宗望克信德府。

translations.literal: On jiazi Zongwang took Xinde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zongwang captured Xinde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丁卯朔，始朝日。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year, on the new moon dingmao in the first month, court audience toward the sun began.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on dingmao, the first month’s new moon, the court held its sun-facing New Year audience.

sentences.zh: 降臣郭藥師、董才皆賜姓完顏氏。

translations.literal: Surrendered ministers Guo Yaoshi and Dong Cai were both granted the surname Wanyan.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered commanders Guo Yaoshi and Dong Cai were both given the surname Wanyan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宗弼取湯陰，大抃攻下浚州，迪古補取黎陽。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Zongbi took Tangyin; Dabian stormed Junzhou; Digubu took Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zongbi seized Tangyin, Dabian stormed Junzhou, and Digubu took Liyang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，諸軍渡河。

translations.literal: On jisi the various armies crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the main forces crossed the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 庚午，取滑州。

translations.literal: On gengwu Huazhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Jin took Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 宗望使吳孝民等入汴，問宋取首謀平山者童貫、譚稹、詹度及張覺等。

translations.literal: Zongwang sent Wu Xiaomin and others into Bian to demand from Song the chief conspirators in the Pingshan affair—Tong Guan, Tan Zhen, Zhan Du, Zhang Jue, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang sent Wu Xiaomin and others into Bian to demand that Song hand over the ringleaders of the Pingshan revolt—Tong Guan, Tan Zhen, Zhan Du, Zhang Jue, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 宋太上皇帝出奔。

translations.literal: The Song retired emperor fled.
translations.idiomatic: The retired Song emperor fled the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，諸軍圍汴。

translations.literal: On guiyou the armies besieged Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Jin armies encircled Bian.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，宋使李棁來謝罪，且請修好。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Song envoy Li Zhi came to confess guilt and seek restored good relations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Song envoy Li Zhi arrived to plead guilty and sue for peace.

sentences.zh: 宗望許宋修好，約質，割三鎮地，增歲幣，載書稱伯侄。

translations.literal: Zongwang granted Song peace on terms of hostages, cession of the three prefectures, increased annual tribute, and a document styled in uncle-nephew terms.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang agreed to peace if Song sent hostages, ceded the three border prefectures, raised the annual tribute, and bound itself in writing as nephew to Jin’s uncle-emperor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，宋以康王構、少宰張邦昌爲質。

translations.literal: On wuyin Song sent the Prince of Kang Gou and Vice Grand Councilor Zhang Bangchang as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Song sent Prince Kang Gou and Vice Grand Councilor Zhang Bangchang as hostages.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，宋上誓書、地圖，稱侄大宋皇帝、伯大金皇帝。

translations.literal: On xinsi Song presented the oath document and maps, styling itself “nephew, Emperor of Great Song” and Jin “uncle, Emperor of Great Jin.”
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Song delivered the oath text and territorial maps, addressing itself as “Nephew, Emperor of Great Song” and Jin as “Uncle, Emperor of Great Jin.”

sentences.zh: 癸未，諸軍解圍。

translations.literal: On guiwei the armies lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the besieging forces withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，夜，宋將姚平仲兵四十萬來襲宗望營，敗之。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the second month’s new moon, at night Song general Yao Pingzhong came with four hundred thousand troops to strike Zongwang’s camp; he was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, New Year’s Day of the second month, Song general Yao Pingzhong led four hundred thousand men in a night assault on Zongwang’s camp and was beaten off.

sentences.zh: 己亥，復進師圍汴。

translations.literal: On jihai the army again advanced and besieged Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Jin forces marched back and laid siege to Bian again.

sentences.zh: 宋使宇文虛中以書來，改以肅王樞爲質，遣康王構歸。

translations.literal: The Song envoy Yuwen Xuzhong came with a letter, substituting Prince Su Shu as hostage and sending the Prince of Kang Gou home.
translations.idiomatic: Song envoy Yuwen Xuzhong arrived with a letter offering Prince Su Shu in place of the hostage and asking that Prince Kang Gou be released.

sentences.zh: 師還。

translations.literal: The army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The army pulled back.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以滑、浚二州與宋。

translations.literal: On renzi Huazhou and Junzhou were given to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Huazhou and Junzhou were returned to Song.

sentences.zh: 宗翰定威勝軍，攻下隆德府。

translations.literal: Zonghan secured Weisheng Army and took Longde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan pacified Weisheng Army and stormed Longde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，次澤州。

translations.literal: On dingsi he halted at Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he encamped at Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 海濱王家奴誣其主欲亡去，詔誅其首惡，余並杖之。

translations.literal: A coastal princely household’s slave slandered his master for intending flight; an edict ordered execution of the ringleaders and beating for the rest.
translations.idiomatic: A slave in a seaboard princely house accused his lord of planning to flee; an edict put the plot’s leaders to death and had the rest flogged.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，銀朮可圍太原，宗翰還西京。

translations.literal: On guiwei in the third month Yinjushke besieged Taiyuan; Zonghan returned to the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the third month Yinjushke invested Taiyuan while Zonghan withdrew to the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 四月癸卯，宗望使宗弼來奏捷。

translations.literal: On guimao in the fourth month Zongwang sent Zongbi to report victory.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the fourth month Zongwang dispatched Zongbi to announce the victory at court.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，耿守忠等大敗宋兵于西都穀。

translations.literal: On yichou Geng Shouzhong and others routed Song troops at Xidu Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Geng Shouzhong and others crushed Song forces in Xidu Valley.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，宋种師中以兵出井陘。

translations.literal: On xinwei in the fifth month Song’s Zhong Shizhong led troops out through Jingxing Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the fifth month Song general Zhong Shizhong marched out by Jingxing Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，完顏活女敗之于殺熊嶺，斬師中于陣。

translations.literal: On guiyou Wanyan Huonü defeated him at Shaxiong Ridge and killed Shizhong in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Wanyan Huonü broke him at Shaxiong Ridge and cut down Shizhong on the field.

sentences.zh: 是日，拔離速敗宋姚古軍于隆州穀。

translations.literal: That day Balisu routed Song Yao Gu’s army at Longzhou Valley.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Balisu drove off Song general Yao Gu’s force in Longzhou Valley.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申朔，高麗國王王楷奉表稱籓。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the sixth month’s new moon, King Wang Kai of Goryeo presented a memorial declaring vassalage.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, New Year’s Day of the sixth month, King Wang Kai of Goryeo submitted a memorial accepting vassal status.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，宗望獻所獲三象。

translations.literal: On gengxu Zongwang presented three elephants taken as booty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zongwang presented three war elephants taken as spoils.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以宗望爲右副元帥。

translations.literal: On gengshen Zongwang was made right deputy marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zongwang was appointed right deputy commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅，遣高伯淑等宣諭高麗。

translations.literal: On bingyin in the seventh month Gao Boshu and others were sent to announce and instruct Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the seventh month Gao Boshu and others were dispatched to proclaim Jin’s will in Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 壬申，出金牌，命孛堇大抃以所領渤海軍八猛安爲萬戶。

translations.literal: On renshen gold plaques were issued, ordering beljen Dabian to make the eight meng’an of the Bohai army he led into wanhu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the court issued gold command plaques, naming beljen Dabian wanhu over the eight meng’an of the Bohai force under his command.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以鐵勒部長奪離剌不從其兄夔里本叛，賜馬十一、豕百、錢五百萬。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Iron Le tribe chief Duolicha was rewarded for not following his elder brother Kuiliben in rebellion—eleven horses, a hundred pigs, and five million cash.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Duolicha, chief of the Iron Le tribe, was rewarded for refusing to join his elder brother Kuiliben’s revolt—eleven horses, a hundred pigs, and five million cash.

sentences.zh: 蕭仲恭使宋還，以所持宋帝與耶律餘睹蠟書自陳。

translations.literal: Xiao Zhonggong returned from his mission to Song and presented a wax-sealed letter from the Song emperor to himself and Yelü Yudu as evidence.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Zhonggong came back from Song and turned in a wax-sealed letter from the Song emperor to him and Yelü Yudu, offered as proof of collusion.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，詔左副元帥宗翰、右副元帥宗望伐宋。

translations.literal: On gengzi in the eighth month an edict ordered left deputy marshal Zonghan and right deputy marshal Zongwang to attack Song.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the eighth month an edict sent left deputy marshal Zonghan and right deputy marshal Zongwang against Song.

sentences.zh: 宋張灝率兵出汾州，拔離速擊走之。

translations.literal: Song Zhang Hao led troops out from Fenzhou; Balisu drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Song’s Zhang Hao marched out of Fenzhou; Balisu beat him back.

sentences.zh: 劉臻以兵出壽陽，婁室破之。

translations.literal: Liu Zhen led troops out from Shouyang; Wosai defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhen advanced from Shouyang; Wosai routed him.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，宗翰發西京。

translations.literal: On gengxu Zonghan set out from the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zonghan marched from the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，婁室等破宋張灝軍于文水。

translations.literal: On xinhai Wosai and others routed Song Zhang Hao’s army at Wenshui.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wosai and others shattered Zhang Hao’s Song army on the Wenshui.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，宗望發保州。

translations.literal: On guichou Zongwang set out from Baozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Zongwang marched from Baozhou.

sentences.zh: 是日，耶律鐸破宋兵于雄州，那野等敗宋兵于中山。

translations.literal: That day Yelü Duo routed Song troops at Xiongzhou; Naye and others defeated Song troops at Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Yelü Duo broke Song forces at Xiongzhou while Naye and others defeated them at Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，新城縣進白烏。

translations.literal: On jiayin Xincheng County presented a white crow.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Xincheng County offered up a white crow as an omen.

sentences.zh: 庚申，突拈取新樂。

translations.literal: On gengshen Tujian took Xinle.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Tujian captured Xinle.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，宗翰克太原，執經略使張孝純。

translations.literal: On bingyin in the ninth month Zonghan took Taiyuan and seized pacification commissioner Zhang Xiaochun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the ninth month Zonghan stormed Taiyuan and took pacification commissioner Zhang Xiaochun prisoner.

sentences.zh: 鶻沙虎取平遙、靈石、孝義、介休諸縣。

translations.literal: Hushahu took Pingyao, Lingshi, Xiaoyi, Jiexiu, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Hushahu overran Pingyao, Lingshi, Xiaoyi, Jiexiu, and the surrounding counties.

sentences.zh: 己巳，復以南京爲平州。

translations.literal: On jisi the Southern Capital was again renamed Ping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Southern Capital reverted to the name Ping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宗望破宋种師閔于井陘，取天威軍，克真定，殺其守李邈。

translations.literal: On xinwei Zongwang defeated Song Zhong Shimin at Jingxing, took Tianwei Army, captured Zhending, and killed its defender Li Miao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zongwang broke Song’s Zhong Shimin at Jingxing, seized Tianwei Army, took Zhending, and executed the garrison commander Li Miao.

sentences.zh: 十月，婁室克汾州，石州降。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Wosai took Fenzhou; Shizhou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wosai captured Fenzhou and Shizhou came over.

sentences.zh: 蒲察克平定軍，遼州降。

translations.literal: Pucha took Pingding Army; Liaozhou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha reduced Pingding Army and Liaozhou submitted.

sentences.zh: 丁未，天清節，高麗、夏遣使來賀，中京進嘉禾。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the Tianqing Festival, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate; the Central Capital presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Tianqing Festival, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys, and the Central Capital presented stalks of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，宗翰自太原趨汴。

translations.literal: On jiazi in the eleventh month Zonghan marched from Taiyuan toward Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eleventh month Zonghan drove from Taiyuan toward Bian.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宗望自真定趨汴。

translations.literal: On bingyin Zongwang marched from Zhending toward Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zongwang drove from Zhending toward Bian.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宗翰下威勝軍。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Zonghan reduced Weisheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zonghan took Weisheng Army.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，撒剌荅破天井關。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Salazada broke through Tianjing Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Salazada forced Tianjing Pass.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宗翰克隆德府。

translations.literal: On yihai, Zonghan took Longde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zonghan stormed Longde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 活女渡盟津。

translations.literal: Huonü crossed Meng Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Huonü forded the Meng crossing.

sentences.zh: 西京、永安軍、鄭州皆降。

translations.literal: The Western Capital, Yong’an Army, and Zhengzhou all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital, Yong’an Army, and Zhengzhou all came over.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宗翰克澤州。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Zonghan took Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Zonghan seized Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宗望諸軍渡河，臨河、大名二縣、德清軍、開德府皆下。

translations.literal: Zongwang’s armies crossed the river; Linhe, the two counties of Daming, Deqing Army, and Kaide Prefecture all fell.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang’s columns crossed the Yellow River; Linhe, Daming’s two counties, Deqing Army, and Kaide Prefecture were all taken.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，克懷州。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Huaizhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Jin took Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 是日，宗望至汴。

translations.literal: That day Zongwang reached Bian.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Zongwang arrived at Bian.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬辰朔，宋出兵拒戰，宗望等擊敗之。

translations.literal: On the renchen new moon of the intercalary month, Song sent troops to resist; Zongwang and the others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary month’s new moon, renchen, Song marched out to give battle; Zongwang and his commanders broke them.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，宗翰至汴。

translations.literal: On guisi, Zonghan reached Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zonghan joined the siege at Bian.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，克汴城。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Bian city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the walls of Bian fell.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以高隨充高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Gao Sui was made envoy for the Goryeo birthday mission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Gao Sui was appointed envoy to congratulate Goryeo on the royal birthday.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，宋主桓出居青城。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Song ruler Huan left to reside at Qingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Song emperor Huan withdrew to the Qingcheng compound.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，宋主桓降，是日，歸于汴城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on guihai, Song ruler Huan surrendered; that day he returned to Bian city.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the twelfth month Song emperor Huan submitted; that same day he was brought back into Bian.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔曰：「朕惟國家，四境雖遠而兵革未息，田野雖廣而畎畝未辟，百工略備而祿秩未均，方貢僅修而賓館未贍。

translations.literal: An edict said: “We consider the state: though the four borders are far, war has not ceased; though the fields are broad, furrows are not yet opened; the hundred crafts are broadly in place but salaries and ranks are not yet equitable; tribute from the regions is only beginning to be maintained but guest lodges are not yet supplied.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ran: “We look upon the realm: the four quarters stretch far yet the clatter of arms has not ended; the farmlands are wide yet the plow has not touched every acre; the hundred crafts stand ready yet pay and rank are still uneven; regional tribute flows in but only in trickles, and the halls that receive guests are still bare.

sentences.zh: 是皆出乎民力，苟不務本業而抑遊手，欲上下皆足，其可得乎？

translations.literal: All these draw upon the people’s strength—if we do not urge the primary occupation and restrain idlers, can we hope that above and below alike will have enough?
translations.idiomatic: All this weighs upon the people’s backs. Unless we hold fast to the root occupation and curb the idle hand, how shall high and low alike have their fill?

sentences.zh: 其令所在長吏，敦勸農功。」

translations.literal: Let the chief officials in each place earnestly exhort agricultural work.”
translations.idiomatic: Let every local chief magistrate press home the duty of farming.”

sentences.zh: 五年正月辛卯朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on the xinmao new moon of the first month, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the first month’s new year, xinmao, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，宗翰、宗望使使以宋降表來上。

translations.literal: On guisi, Zonghan and Zongwang sent envoys presenting Song’s surrender memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zonghan and Zongwang dispatched envoys to court with Song’s written submission.

sentences.zh: 乙未，知樞密院事劉彥宗上表，請復立趙氏，不聽。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Privy Council Affairs Commissioner Liu Yanzong memorialized asking that the Zhao house be restored; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Liu Yanzong, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, petitioned to set a Zhao on the Song throne again; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，回鶻喝里可汗遣使入貢。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Uyghur Kaghan Heli sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Uyghur khan Heli sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，詔曰：「自河之北，今既分畫，重念其民或見城邑有被殘者，不無疑懼，遂命堅守。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on gengshen, an edict said: “North of the river has now been partitioned anew; we think again of the people—some have seen towns ravaged and cannot but fear, so we ordered garrisons to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the sixth month an edict ran: “The lands north of the river are now redrawn. We weigh the people’s hearts—where they have seen cities wrecked, dread is only natural, and we therefore ordered the walls held.

sentences.zh: 若即討伐，生靈可湣。

translations.literal: If we strike at once, the living will be pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: To march on them straightway would be to slaughter the innocent.

sentences.zh: 其申諭以理，招輯安全之。

translations.literal: Explain the reason to them and summon them to submit in safety.
translations.idiomatic: Reason with them and win them back in peace.

sentences.zh: 儻執不移，自當致討。

translations.literal: If they cling obstinately, then let punishment be brought upon them.
translations.idiomatic: Should they still resist, then let the armies go in.

sentences.zh: 若諸軍敢利于俘掠輒肆蕩毀者，底于罰。

translations.literal: If any force dares to profit from captives and looting and wantonly ravage and destroy, let the penalty reach to the bottom.”
translations.idiomatic: Any commander who turns to plunder and ruin shall answer for it to the full.”

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，右副元帥宗望薨。

translations.literal: On gengchen, right deputy commander-in-chief Zongwang died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the right deputy commander-in-chief Zongwang died.

sentences.zh: 漢國王宗傑繼薨。

translations.literal: Han State King Zongjie also died soon after.
translations.idiomatic: The Han State King Zongjie followed him to the grave.

sentences.zh: 七月甲午，賜宗翰券書，除反逆外，鹹貰勿論。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on jiawu, commission patents were granted to Zonghan; except for treason, all bribery and corruption were forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the seventh month Zonghan received blank commission patents—save for rebellion, every stain of graft was wiped clean.

sentences.zh: 以石州戍將烏虎棄城喪師，杖之，削其宮。

translations.literal: Because Shizhou garrison commander Wuhu abandoned his post and lost his army, he was flogged and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Wuhu, garrison commander of Shizhou, had fled his city and lost his command; he was beaten and dismissed from rank.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，以宋捷，遣耶律居謹等充宣慶使使高麗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on wuyin, because of the victory over Song, Yelü Jujin and others were made Xuanqing envoys to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the eighth month, with Song subdued, Yelü Jujin and others were sent to Goryeo as envoys bearing the news of triumph.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以宗輔爲右副元帥。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Zongfu was made right deputy commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zongfu was appointed right deputy commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「河北、河東郡縣職員多闕，宜開貢舉取士，以安新民。

translations.literal: An edict said: “In the prefectures and counties of Hebei and Hedong many posts stand vacant; the civil-service examinations should be opened to take scholars and settle the new subjects.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ran: “Hebei and Hedong are short of officials in town after town; open the examinations, choose men of talent, and give the new people stable rule.

sentences.zh: 其南北進士，各以所業試之。」

translations.literal: Let the jinshi of north and south each be tested in his own specialty.”
translations.idiomatic: Let northern and southern degree-holders be examined each in the art he professes.”

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，詔曰：「內地諸路，每耕牛一具賦粟五鬥，以備歉歲。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on dingwei, an edict said: “In the interior circuits, for every plow team levy five dou of grain against lean years.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the ninth month an edict ran: “On every interior circuit, for each team of oxen under the plow, levy five dou of grain against famine years.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，賜元帥右監軍完顏希尹、萬戶銀朮可券書，除赦所不原，餘並勿論。

translations.literal: On xinhai, commission patents were granted to the commander’s right army supervisor Wanyan Xiyin and the wanhu Yinjushke; except what the amnesty does not pardon, all else was forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai blank patents went to the commander’s right army supervisor Wanyan Xiyin and the wanhu Yinjushke—everything the general amnesty spared aside, the rest was cleared.

sentences.zh: 闍母取河間，大敗宋兵于莫州，雄州降。

translations.literal: Shemu took Hejian, routed Song forces at Mozhou, and Xiongzhou submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shemu seized Hejian, shattered Song troops at Mozhou, and Xiongzhou came over.

sentences.zh: 撻懶克祁州，永寧軍、保州、順安軍皆降。

translations.literal: Talan took Qizhou; Yongning Army, Baozhou, and Shun’an Army all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Talan reduced Qizhou; Yongning Army, Baozhou, and Shun’an Army all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，沙州回鶻活剌散可汗遣使入貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on dingmao, Shazhou Uyghur Kaghan Huolasan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the tenth month of winter the Shazhou Uyghur khan Huolasan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛未，天清節，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the Tianqing Festival, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Tianqing Festival, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 宋二帝自燕徙居于中京。

translations.literal: The two Song emperors were moved from Yan to dwell at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The two captive Song emperors were transferred from Yan to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 六年正月丙戌朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on the bingxu new moon of the first month, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the first month’s new year, bingxu, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 宗弼破宋鄭宗孟軍于青州。

translations.literal: Zongbi defeated Song general Zheng Zongmeng’s army at Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingzhou Zongbi broke the army of Song’s Zheng Zongmeng.

sentences.zh: 銀朮可取鄧州。

translations.literal: Yinjushke took Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yinjushke seized Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 薩謀魯入襄陽。

translations.literal: Samunulu entered Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Samunulu marched into Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 拔離速入均州。

translations.literal: Balisu entered Jun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Balisu entered Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 馬五取房州。

translations.literal: Ma Wu took Fang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Wu reduced Fang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，克青州。

translations.literal: On guisi, Qingzhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Jin took Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，闍母克濰州。

translations.literal: On guimao, Shemu took Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Shemu captured Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，迪古補敗宋將趙子昉兵。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Digubu defeated the troops of Song general Zhao Zifang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Digubu routed the army of Song general Zhao Zifang.

sentences.zh: 撒離喝敗宋于河上。

translations.literal: Salihe defeated Song on the river.
translations.idiomatic: Salihe beat Song forces on the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，宋將馬括兵次樂安，宗輔擊敗之，聞宋主在維揚，以農時還師。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Song general Ma Kuo’s army halted at Le’an; Zongfu attacked and defeated it; hearing the Song ruler was at Weiyang, he withdrew the army because of the farming season.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Song general Ma Kuo encamped at Le’an; Zongfu struck and broke him; learning the Song emperor was at Weiyang, he marched back for the planting season.

sentences.zh: 宗弼敗宋兵于河上。

translations.literal: Zongbi defeated Song troops on the river.
translations.idiomatic: Zongbi routed Song forces on the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯朔，拔離速取唐州，癸亥，取蔡州。

translations.literal: On yimao, first day of the second month, Balisu took Tang Prefecture; on guihai he took Cai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, New Year’s Day of the second month, Balisu seized Tang Prefecture; on guihai he took Cai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，移剌古敗宋將台宗雋等兵于大名。

translations.literal: On jisi, Yelü Gu defeated the troops of Song generals Tai Zongjun and others at Daming.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Yelü Gu broke Song generals Tai Zongjun and the rest at Daming.

sentences.zh: 庚午，再破其軍，獲台宗雋及宋忠。

translations.literal: On gengwu he again broke their army and captured Tai Zongjun and Song Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he routed them again and took Tai Zongjun and Song Zhong prisoner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，拔離速取陳州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Balisu took Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Balisu captured Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，克穎昌府。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Yingchang Prefecture was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Jin took Yingchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 鄭州叛入于宋，復取鄭州。

translations.literal: Zheng Prefecture rebelled and went over to Song; it was taken again.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Prefecture defected to Song and was recovered.

sentences.zh: 遷洛陽、襄陽、穎昌、汝、鄭、均、房、唐、鄧、陳、蔡之民于河北。

translations.literal: The people of Luoyang, Xiangyang, Yingchang, Ru, Zheng, Jun, Fang, Tang, Deng, Chen, and Cai were moved to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Populations from Luoyang, Xiangyang, Yingchang, Ru, Zheng, Jun, Fang, Tang, Deng, Chen, and Cai were relocated to Hebei.

sentences.zh: 宗翰復遣婁室攻下同、華、京兆、鳳翔，擒宋經制使傅亮。

translations.literal: Zonghan again sent Loushi to attack and take Tong, Hua, Jingzhao, and Fengxiang, capturing Song frontier commissioner Fu Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan again dispatched Loushi to reduce Tong, Hua, Jingzhao, and Fengxiang and seize Song frontier commissioner Fu Liang.

sentences.zh: 阿鄰破河中。

translations.literal: Alin broke Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Alin overran Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 斡魯入馮翊。

translations.literal: Wolu entered Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: Wolu marched into Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，命南路軍帥實古乃，籍節度使完顏慎思所領諸部及未置猛安謀克戶來上。

translations.literal: In the third month on renchen, the southern-route army commander Shigunai was ordered to register the commands under Military Commissioner Wanyan Shensi and households not yet assigned to meng’an-moke units and report them upward.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the third month Shigunai, commander of the southern route army, was told to muster the units under Military Commissioner Wanyan Shensi and every household not yet placed in a meng’an-moke register and submit the rolls to court.

sentences.zh: 己酉，撻懶下恩州。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Tadalan reduced En Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Tadalan took En Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，移沙土古思以本部來附。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on wuxu, Yishatugusi came in submission with his tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuxu, Yishatugusi submitted with his tribal following.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，詔求祖宗遺事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on jiwei, an edict sought surviving records of the ancestors’ deeds.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiwei, an edict called for accounts of the ancestors’ deeds still in memory.

sentences.zh: 撻懶遣兵徇下磁州、信德府。

translations.literal: Tadalan sent troops to overrun and take Cizhou and Xinde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tadalan sent columns to sweep Cizhou and Xinde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 真定賊自稱元帥，秦王撒離喝討平之。

translations.literal: At Zhending bandits styled themselves marshal; Prince of Qin Salihe suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhending rebels proclaimed a marshal; the Prince of Qin, Salihe, crushed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 七月乙巳，宋主遣使奉表請和，詔進兵伐之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on yisi, the Song ruler sent envoys with a memorial begging peace; an edict ordered the armies to advance and attack.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the seventh month the Song emperor sent envoys suing for peace; the court answered with orders to press the campaign.

sentences.zh: 以宋二庶人赴上京。

translations.literal: The two Song commoners were sent to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The two deposed Song emperors were escorted to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，婁室敗宋兵于華州，訛特剌破敵于渭水，遂取下邽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on yimao, Loushi defeated Song troops at Hua Prefecture; Wotela broke the enemy at the Wei River and thereupon took Xiaji.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the eighth month Loushi routed Song at Hua Prefecture; Wotela shattered the foe on the Wei and then seized Xiaji.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以宋二庶人素服見太祖廟，遂入見于乾元殿。

translations.literal: On dingchou the two Song commoners, in plain dress, were presented at the Taizu Temple and then received audience in the Qianyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the two captive Song emperors, clad in white, paid homage at the Taizu Temple and were then received in the Qianyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 封其父昏德公、子重昏侯。

translations.literal: His father was enfeoffed Duke of Hunde and his son Marquis of Chonghun.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong was titled Duke of Hunde and Qinzong Marquis of Chonghun.

sentences.zh: 是日，告于太祖廟。

translations.literal: That day the victory was announced at the Taizu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the triumph was reported at the Taizu Temple.

sentences.zh: 以州郡職員名稱及俸給因革詔中外。

translations.literal: An edict to the empire set out changes in prefectural and county posts, titles, and salaries.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the whole realm laid out reforms of local office titles and pay.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，蒲察、婁室取延安府。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on gengyin, Pucha and Loushi took Yan’an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the eleventh month Pucha and Loushi seized Yan’an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賑移懶路。

translations.literal: On renchen, relief was given to the Yilan Route.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the court distributed relief on the Yilan Route.

sentences.zh: 乙未，取濮州，綏德軍降。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Pu Prefecture was taken and Suide Army surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Jin took Pu Prefecture and Suide Army came over.

sentences.zh: 婁室再攻晉寧軍，其守徐徽言固守，不能克。

translations.literal: Loushi again attacked Jinning Army; its defender Xu Huiyan held firm and could not be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Loushi invested Jinning Army again, but defender Xu Huiyan held out and the place would not fall.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，宗弼取開德府。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on bingchen, Zongbi took Kaide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the twelfth month Zongbi captured Kaide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宗輔克大名府。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Zongfu took Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Zongfu seized Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 鶻沙虎敗宋兵于鞏。

translations.literal: Hushahu defeated Song troops at Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Hushahu routed Song forces at Gong.

sentences.zh: 七年正月庚辰朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, on gengchen, first day of the first month, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on gengchen, New Year’s Day of the first month, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，吳國王闍母薨。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Wu State King Zhamu died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Wu State King Zhamu died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以西京留守韓企先同中書門下平章事、知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Western Capital regent Han Qixian was made joint policy-maker of the Secretariat-Chancellery and director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Han Qixian, regent at the Western Capital, was appointed joint policy-maker of the Secretariat-Chancellery and director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，宋麟府路安撫使折可求以麟、府、豐三州降。

translations.literal: In the second month on wuchen, Song Lin-Fu Circuit pacification commissioner Zhe Keqiu surrendered Lin, Fu, and Feng prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the second month Song’s Lin-Fu Circuit pacification commissioner Zhe Keqiu yielded Lin, Fu, and Feng prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己巳，婁室、塞里、鶻沙虎等破晉寧軍，其守徐徽言據子城拒戰。

translations.literal: On jisi, Loushi, Saili, Hushahu, and others broke Jinning Army; its defender Xu Huiyan held the inner citadel and resisted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Loushi, Saili, Hushahu, and the rest stormed Jinning Army; defender Xu Huiyan barred himself in the inner ward and fought on.

sentences.zh: 庚午，率衆潰圍走，擒之。

translations.literal: On gengwu he led the crowd in a breakout and flight; he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he led his men in a desperate sortie and was taken.

sentences.zh: 使之拜，不拜。

translations.literal: They ordered him to bow; he would not bow.
translations.idiomatic: They commanded him to bow; he refused.

sentences.zh: 臨之以兵，不動。

translations.literal: Soldiers were ranged against him; he did not stir.
