translations.idiomatic: They threatened him with arms; he did not flinch.

sentences.zh: 命降將折可求諭之降，指可求大罵，出不遜語，遂殺之。

translations.literal: The surrendered Song general Zhe Keqiu was ordered to urge him to submit; he pointed at Keqiu and reviled him with insolent words, and so was killed.
translations.idiomatic: A surrendered Song officer, Zhe Keqiu, was sent to persuade him; he pointed at Keqiu and cursed him with the foulest abuse, and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 其統制孫昂及士卒皆不屈，盡殺之。

translations.literal: His commander Sun Ang and the soldiers all refused to yield and were put to death to the last man.
translations.idiomatic: His commander Sun Ang and every soldier who would not submit were slaughtered.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔禁醫巫閭山遼代陵樵采。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict forbade physicians, shamans, and woodcutting at the Liao tombs on Yiwulü Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict barred physicians, shamans, and timber-cutting at the Liao imperial tombs on Yiwulü Mountain.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯朔，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: In the third month on jimao, first day of the month, there was a black spot in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, New Year’s Day of the third month, a black spot appeared on the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔軍興以來，良人被略爲驅者，聽其父母夫妻子贖之。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict: since the armies were raised, good people who were carried off as captives—let parents, husbands, wives, and children redeem them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict ruled that, since the war began, civilians seized as booty might be redeemed by their parents, spouses, and children.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射高楨罷。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Gao Zhen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Gao Zhen was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 四月，蒲察、婁室取鄜、坊二州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Pucha and Loushi took Fu and Fang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Pucha and Loushi seized Fu and Fang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，拔離速等襲宋主于揚州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on yimao, Balisu and others raided the Song ruler at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao, Balisu and others struck at the Song emperor in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On bingwu, first day of the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, New Year’s Day of the ninth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，宗弼敗宋兵于睢陽。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Zongbi defeated Song troops at Suiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zongbi routed Song forces at Suiyang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，降其城。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the city surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the city submitted.

sentences.zh: 是月，曹州降。

translations.literal: That month, Cao Prefecture surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: That month Cao Prefecture came over.

sentences.zh: 十月丙子朔，京兆府降。

translations.literal: On bingzi, first day of the tenth month, Jingzhao Prefecture surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, New Year’s Day of the tenth month, Jingzhao Prefecture submitted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，鞏州降。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Gong Prefecture surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Gong Prefecture came over.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，天清節，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the Tianqing Festival; Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Tianqing Festival, Goryeo and Western Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，阿里、當海、大抃破敵于壽春。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Ali, Danghai, and Dabian defeated the enemy at Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Ali, Danghai, and Dabian broke the enemy at Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 己亥，安撫使馬世元以城降。

translations.literal: On jihai, Pacification Commissioner Ma Shiyuan surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Pacification Commissioner Ma Shiyuan turned the city over.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，廬州降。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Luzhou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Luzhou submitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，徙曷蘇館都統司治寧州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on gengxu, the Yisu Guan Commandery was moved to govern from Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the eleventh month the Yisu Guan Commandery was relocated to Ning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On yimao, Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Goryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，宗弼取和州。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Zongbi took He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Zongbi seized He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，宗弼渡江，敗宋副元帥杜充軍于江寧。

translations.literal: On renxu, Zongbi crossed the Yangtze and defeated the army of Song vice commander-in-chief Du Chong at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zongbi crossed the Yangtze and routed Song vice commander-in-chief Du Chong at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，守臣陳邦光以城降。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the defending official Chen Bangguang surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the garrison commander Chen Bangguang opened the gates.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，宗弼取湖州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on bingxu, Zongbi took Hu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the twelfth month Zongbi took Hu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，克杭州。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Hang Prefecture was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Hang Prefecture fell.

sentences.zh: 阿里、蒲盧渾追宋主于明州。

translations.literal: Ali and Pulu Hun pursued the Song ruler to Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ali and Pulu Hun chased the Song emperor toward Ming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 越州降。

translations.literal: Yue Prefecture surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Prefecture submitted.

sentences.zh: 大抃敗宋樞密使周望于秀州，又敗宋兵于杭州東北。

translations.literal: Dabian defeated Song Privy Councillor Zhou Wang at Xiu Prefecture and again defeated Song troops northeast of Hang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dabian broke Song Privy Councillor Zhou Wang at Xiu Prefecture, then routed Song forces northeast of Hang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，阿里、蒲盧渾敗宋兵于東關，遂濟曹娥江。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Ali and Pulu Hun defeated Song troops at Dong Pass and then crossed the Cao’e River.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Ali and Pulu Hun routed Song forces at Dong Pass and crossed the Cao’e River.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，敗宋兵于高橋。

translations.literal: On renyin, Song troops were defeated at Gao Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Jin defeated Song forces at Gao Bridge.

sentences.zh: 宋主入于海。

translations.literal: The Song ruler fled onto the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Song emperor took to the sea.

sentences.zh: 八年正月甲辰朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the first month on jiachen, first day of the month, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, New Year’s Day of the first month of the eighth year, Goryeo and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以同中書門下平章事韓企先爲尚書左僕射兼侍中。

translations.literal: On dingsi, joint Secretariat-Chancellery policy-maker Han Qixian was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Han Qixian, joint policy-maker of the Secretariat-Chancellery, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 己未，阿里、蒲盧渾克明州，執其守臣趙伯諤。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Ali and Pulu Hun took Ming Prefecture and seized its defending official Zhao Boyi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Ali and Pulu Hun captured Ming Prefecture and took its defender Zhao Boyi prisoner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔曰「避役之民，以微直鬻身權貴之家者，悉出還本貫。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict said: “People who sold themselves to powerful households for a trifling price to avoid corvée service—all are to be released and returned to their native registers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict declared: “Those who sold themselves cheaply into great families to escape corvée—all shall be freed and sent back to their home registers.

sentences.zh: 」阿魯補、斜里也下太平、順昌及濠州。

translations.literal: ” Alubu and Xieliye reduced Taiping, Shunchang, and Hao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: ” Alubu and Xieliye overran Taiping, Shunchang, and Hao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋副元帥杜充以其衆降。

translations.literal: That month, Song vice commander-in-chief Du Chong surrendered with his forces.
translations.idiomatic: That month Song vice commander-in-chief Du Chong came over with his army.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，宗弼還自杭州。

translations.literal: In the second month on yihai, Zongbi returned from Hang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the second month Zongbi marched back from Hang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，取秀州。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Xiu Prefecture was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Jin took Xiu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，取平江。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Pingjiang was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Pingjiang fell.

sentences.zh: 汴京亂，三月丁卯，大迪里復取之。

translations.literal: Bianjing was in turmoil; in the third month on dingmao, Dadili recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: Bianjing erupted in disorder; on dingmao in the third month Dadili retook it.

sentences.zh: 宗弼及宋韓世忠戰于鎮江，不利。

translations.literal: Zongbi fought Song’s Han Shizhong at Zhenjiang and did not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhenjiang Zongbi clashed with Song’s Han Shizhong and came off worse.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申，復戰于江寧，敗之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on bingshen, he fought again at Jiangning and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the fourth month he fought again at Jiangning and broke Han Shizhong.

sentences.zh: 諸軍渡江。

translations.literal: The armies crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: Jin forces crossed the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 是日，阿魯補戰于拓皋，己亥，周企戰于壽春，辛丑，婁室戰于淳化，皆勝之。

translations.literal: That day Alubu fought at Tuogao; on jihai Zhou Qi fought at Shouchun; on xinchou Lou Shi fought at Chunhua—all were victorious.
translations.idiomatic: That day Alubu won at Tuogao; on jihai Zhou Qi at Shouchun; on xinchou Lou Shi at Chunhua—each carried the day.

sentences.zh: 醴州降，遂克邠州。

translations.literal: Li Prefecture surrendered, and then Bin Prefecture was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Li Prefecture submitted, and Bin Prefecture was seized.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，禁私度僧尼及繼父繼母之男女無相嫁娶。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on guimao, private ordination of monks and nuns was forbidden, as was marriage between stepchildren of the same stepfather or stepmother.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the fifth month the court forbade unauthorized ordination of monks and nuns and marriage among step-siblings of one step-parent.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「河北、河東簽軍。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict said: “Conscript soldiers of Hebei and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict ran: “For conscript soldiers of Hebei and Hedong,

sentences.zh: 其家屬流寓河南被俘掠爲奴婢者，官爲贖之，俾復其業。

translations.literal: whose families, displaced into Henan, were captured and enslaved—the government shall redeem them and restore them to their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: whose kin, stranded in Henan, were seized as slaves—the state shall ransom them and set them back in their trades.

sentences.zh: 」六月壬申，詔遣遼統軍使耶律曷禮質、節度使蕭別離剌等十人。

translations.literal: ” In the sixth month on renshen, an edict dispatched ten men, including Liao frontier commander Yelü Helizhi and military commissioner Xiao Bielici.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the sixth month, on renshen, an edict sent ten officials, among them Liao frontier commander Yelü Helizhi and military commissioner Xiao Bielici.

sentences.zh: 分治新附州鎮。

translations.literal: They were to administer the newly submitted prefectures and garrisons separately.
translations.idiomatic: They were assigned to govern the newly submitted prefectures and posts.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔以昏德公六女爲宗婦。

translations.literal: On guiyou, an edict made six daughters of the Duke of Hunde imperial consorts by marriage.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict gave six daughters of Huizong (the Duke of Hunde) as wives to imperial clansmen.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，詔給泰州都統婆盧火所部諸謀克甲胄各五十。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on xinhai, an edict granted fifty suits of armor each to the meng’an units under Taizhou commander Baluhuo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the seventh month the court issued fifty suits of armor apiece to the meng’an companies under Taizhou commander Baluhuo.

sentences.zh: 先遣婁室經略陝西，所下城邑叛服不常，其監戰阿盧補請益兵。

translations.literal: Lou Shi had earlier been sent to pacify Shaanxi; the cities he took rebelled and submitted by turns, and his battle overseer Alubu requested reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi had been sent earlier to pacify Shaanxi, but towns he seized wavered between revolt and submission, and his overseer Alubu asked for more troops.

sentences.zh: 帥府會諸將議曰：「兵威非不足，綏懷之道有所未盡。

translations.literal: The commandery met with the generals and deliberated, saying: “Military might is not insufficient; what is lacking is a full policy of reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: The headquarters summoned the generals and said: “Force alone is not the trouble—we have not yet won hearts and minds.

sentences.zh: 誠得位望隆重、恩威兼濟者以往，可指日而定。

translations.literal: If someone of high standing whose favor and awe are both complete were sent, the region could be settled within days.
translations.idiomatic: Send a man of rank who can blend kindness with terror, and the west could be settled in days.

sentences.zh: 若以皇子右副元帥宗輔往，爲宜。

translations.literal: It would be fitting to send the imperial prince, Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Zong Fu.
translations.idiomatic: The prince, Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Zong Fu, would be the right choice.

sentences.zh: 」以聞。

translations.literal: ” This was reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: ” The recommendation was sent to the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「婁室往者所向輒克，今使專征陝西，淹延未定，豈倦于兵而自愛耶？

translations.literal: An edict said: “Loushi in the past wherever he went always conquered; now, sent on exclusive campaign in Shaanxi, he delays and has not settled the matter—is he weary of war and sparing himself?”
translations.idiomatic: An edict ran: “Loushi once took every field he entered; now, with sole command in Shaanxi, he lingers without a finish—has he grown tired of fighting and begun to spare himself?”

sentences.zh: 關、陝重地，卿等其戮力焉。

translations.literal: Guan and Shaan are vital regions—you all must exert your strength.”
translations.idiomatic: Guan and Shaanxi are the hinge of the realm—bring all your strength to bear.”

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，上如東京溫湯。

translations.literal: On dingmao the emperor went to the hot springs at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor traveled to the Eastern Capital baths.

sentences.zh: 徙昏德公、重昏侯于鶻里改路。

translations.literal: The Duke of Hunde and the Marquis of Chonghun were moved to Heligai Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong, Duke of Hunde, and Qinzong, Marquis of Chonghun, were relocated to Heligai Circuit.

sentences.zh: 九年正月己亥朔，齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, on jihai, New Year’s Day; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: New Year’s Day of the ninth year fell on jihai; Qi, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory embassies.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命以徒門水以西，渾疃、星顯、僝蠢三水以北閒田，給曷懶路諸謀克。

translations.literal: On wushen, an order granted idle lands west of the Tumen River and north of the Huntun, Xingxian, and Chanchun rivers to the meng’an of Yilan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the court allotted fallow fields west of the Tumen and north of the Huntun, Xingxian, and Chanchun rivers to Yilan Circuit’s meng’an companies.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，蒲察鶻拔魯、完顏忒里討張萬敵于白馬湖，陷于敵。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Pucha Hebalu and Wanyan Teli attacked Zhang Wandi at White Horse Lake and were trapped by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Pucha Hebalu and Wanyan Teli moved against Zhang Wandi at White Horse Lake and were cut off by the foe.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以同中書門下平章事時立愛爲侍中，知樞密院張忠嗣爲宣政殿大學士、知三司使事。

translations.literal: On guichou, Tong Zhongshu Menxia Pingzhangshi Shi Li’ai was made Shizhong; Privy Council Director Zhang Zhongsi was made Xuanzheng Hall Grand Academician and Commissioner of the Three Commissariats.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Shi Li’ai, Tong Zhongshu Menxia Pingzhangshi, was promoted to Shizhong; Zhang Zhongsi of the Privy Council became Xuanzheng Hall Grand Academician and head of the Three Commissariats.

sentences.zh: 宗弼、阿盧補撫定鞏、洮、河、樂、西寧、蘭、廓、積石等州。

translations.literal: Zongbi and Alubu pacified Gong, Tao, He, Le, Xining, Lan, Kuo, Jishi, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Zongbi and Alubu brought Gong, Tao, He, Le, Xining, Lan, Kuo, Jishi, and the rest under control.

sentences.zh: 涇原、熙河兩路皆平。

translations.literal: The Jingyuan and Xihe circuits were both pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan and Xihe circuits were fully subdued.

sentences.zh: 四月己卯，詔「新徙戍邊戶，匱于衣食，有典質其親屬奴婢者，官爲贖之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on jimao, an edict: “Newly relocated frontier-guard households, short of food and clothing, who have pawned relatives or slaves—the government shall redeem them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the fourth month an edict declared: “Frontier households just moved to the border, destitute for food and clothes, who pawned kin or slaves—the state will redeem them.

sentences.zh: 戶計其口而有二三者，以官奴婢益之，使戶爲四口。

translations.literal: Households that count only two or three mouths shall be supplemented with government slaves so that each household has four persons.
translations.idiomatic: Where a household numbers only two or three, official bondsmen shall be added until it reaches four souls.

sentences.zh: 又乏耕牛者，給以官牛，別委官勸督田作。

translations.literal: Those also lacking draft oxen shall be given government oxen, and separate officials appointed to urge and supervise fieldwork.
translations.idiomatic: Households without plow cattle shall receive state oxen, with special officers set over them to drive the planting.

sentences.zh: 戍戶及邊軍資糧不繼，傘粟于民而與賑恤。

translations.literal: Where frontier households and border armies lack continuing grain supplies, grain shall be borrowed from the people and relief given.
translations.idiomatic: When garrison families and frontier troops run short of grain, the court may borrow from civilians and issue famine relief.

sentences.zh: 其續遷戍戶在中路者，姑止之，即其地種藝，俟畢獲而行，及來春農時，以至戍所。

translations.literal: Those guard households still en route on the central road shall halt for the present, plant crops where they stand, and travel only after the harvest is in, reaching their posts by the spring planting season.
translations.idiomatic: Relocated guards still on the central route shall pause where they are, sow the fields at hand, and march on only after the crop is gathered, arriving at their posts in time for spring tillage.

sentences.zh: 」五月丙午，分遣使者諸路勸農。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on bingwu, envoys were dispatched on separate routes to encourage agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fifth month the court sent agents along every circuit to promote farming.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，賜昏德公、重昏侯時服各兩襲。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on renchen, the Duke of Hunde and the Marquis of Chonghun were each granted two sets of seasonal robes.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the sixth month the Duke of Hunde and the Marquis of Chonghun each received two suits of seasonal dress.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，回鶻隈欲遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on xinsi, the Uighur Aiwei sent an embassy in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the eighth month the Uighur chief Aiwei presented tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，和州回鶻執耶律大石之黨撒八、迪里、突迭來獻。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on jiyou, the Hezhou Uighurs seized Yelü Dashi’s partisans Saba, Dili, and Tudie and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the ninth month Hezhou Uighurs captured Yelü Dashi’s followers Saba, Dili, and Tudie and sent them in.

sentences.zh: 十月戊寅，天清節，齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on wuyin, the Tianqing Festival; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the tenth month, at the Tianqing Festival, Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory missions.

sentences.zh: 撒離喝攻下慶陽。

translations.literal: Salih took Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Salih reduced Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 慕洧以環州降。

translations.literal: Mu Wei surrendered Huan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Wei brought Huan Prefecture over to Jin.

sentences.zh: 宗弼與宋吳玠戰于和尚原，敗績。

translations.literal: Zongbi fought Song general Wu Jie at Heshang Plain and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Zongbi met Song’s Wu Jie on Heshang Plain and was routed.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，遷趙氏疏屬于上京。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on jiwei, distant members of the Zhao clan were moved to Shangjing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the eleventh month collateral lines of the Zhao house were relocated to Shangjing.

sentences.zh: 以陝西地賜齊。

translations.literal: Shaanxi territory was granted to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: The court ceded Shaanxi to Qi.

sentences.zh: 十年正月癸巳朔，齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year, on guisi, New Year’s Day; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: New Year’s Day of the tenth year fell on guisi; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia again sent embassies of congratulation.

sentences.zh: 己酉，齊表謝賜地。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Qi memorialized thanks for the grant of territory.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Qi submitted a memorial of thanks for the land grant.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔曰：「昔遼人分士庶之族，賦役皆有等差，其悉均之。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict said: “Formerly the Liao divided scholar and commoner clans; taxes and corvée all had graded differences—let all be equalized.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict ran: “Under the Liao, scholar and commoner estates were kept apart and levies were tiered—level them all.

sentences.zh: 」二月庚午，賑上京路戍邊猛安民。

translations.literal: In the second month on gengwu, frontier meng’an people of Shangjing Circuit were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the second month the court relieved frontier meng’an households on the Shangjing circuit.

sentences.zh: 四月丁卯，詔：「諸良人知情嫁奴者，聽如故爲妻，其不知而嫁者，去住悉從所欲。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on dingmao, an edict: “Free persons who knowingly marry slaves may keep them as wives as before; those who marry without knowing may stay or leave entirely as they wish.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the fourth month an edict ruled: “A free man who knowingly weds a slave may keep her as his wife; if he did not know, he may stay or go as he chooses.

sentences.zh: 」移賚勃極烈，左副元帥宗翰朝京師。

translations.literal: Yisai-bolilie, Left Vice Marshal Zonghan, came to court at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yisai-bolilie and Left Vice Marshal Zonghan presented themselves at the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚午，乙太祖孫亶爲諳班勃極烈，皇子宗磐爲國論忽魯勃極烈，國論勃極烈宗幹爲國論左勃極烈，移賚勃極烈、左副元帥宗翰爲國論右勃極烈兼都元帥，右副元帥宗輔爲左副元帥。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Yizu’s grandson Yixuan was made an-ban boji lie; Prince Zongpan was made guolun hulu boji lie; guolun boji lie Zonggan was made guolun left boji lie; Yisai-bolilie and Left Vice Marshal Zonghan were made guolun right boji lie and also Grand Marshal; Right Vice Marshal Zongfu was made Left Vice Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yizu’s grandson Yixuan took the an-ban boji lie seat; Prince Zongpan became guolun hulu boji lie; Zonggan, guolun boji lie, became guolun left boji lie; Yisai-bolilie and Left Vice Marshal Zonghan became guolun right boji lie and Grand Marshal as well; Right Vice Marshal Zongfu was shifted to Left Vice Marshal.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，聞鴨綠、混同江暴漲，命賑徙戍邊戶在混同江者。

translations.literal: On gengyin, hearing that the Yalu and Hun Tong rivers had swollen in flood, an order was given to relieve relocated frontier-guard households on the Hun Tong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, when word came that the Yalu and Hun Tong had burst their banks, the court ordered relief for guard households relocated along the Hun Tong.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛卯，詔分遣鶻沙虎等十三人閱諸路丁壯，調赴軍。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on xinmao, an edict dispatched Gushahu and thirteen others on separate routes to review able-bodied men and assign them to the army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the intercalary month an edict sent Gushahu and thirteen others through every circuit to muster adult males for service.

sentences.zh: 七月甲午，賑泰州路戍邊戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on jiawu, frontier-guard households of Taizhou Circuit were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the seventh month the court relieved frontier guard households on the Taizhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 上如中京。

translations.literal: The emperor went to the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor traveled to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 九月，元帥右都監耶律餘睹謀反，出奔。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Marshal Right Director Yelü Yudu plotted rebellion and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Right Director of Marshals Yelü Yudu rose in treason and absconded.

sentences.zh: 其党燕京統軍使蕭高六伏誅，蔚州節度使蕭特謀葛自殺。

translations.literal: His partisans—the Yanjing military commissioner Xiao Gao6—were executed; the Wei Prefecture military governor Xiao Temuge killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: His faction paid: Yanjing military commissioner Xiao Gao6 was put to death, and Wei Prefecture governor Xiao Temuge took his own life.

sentences.zh: 十月壬寅，天清節，大赦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on renyin, the Tianqing Festival; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the tenth month, at the Tianqing Festival, the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory embassies.

sentences.zh: 上如興中府。

translations.literal: The emperor went to Xingzhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor journeyed to Xingzhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 齊使使來告母喪。

translations.literal: Qi sent envoys to announce the death of the ruler’s mother.
translations.idiomatic: Qi dispatched envoys to report the queen mother’s death.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，以武良謨爲齊弔祭使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on guihai, Wu Liangmo was made condolence envoy to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the eleventh month Wu Liangmo was appointed envoy of mourning to Qi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，撒離喝請取劍外十三州，從之。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Salih requested the thirteen prefectures beyond the Sword Pass; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Salih asked to take the thirteen prefectures west of Jianmen Pass, and the court assented.

sentences.zh: 部族節度使土古廝捕斬余睹及其諸子，函其首來獻。

translations.literal: Tribal military commissioner Tugusi captured and killed Yudu and his sons, boxed their heads, and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal commissioner Tugusi ran Yudu and his sons to ground, beheaded them, and sent the heads to court in coffers.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，撒離喝克金州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on gengzi, Salih took Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the twelfth month Salih seized Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 上至自興中府。

translations.literal: The emperor returned from Xingzhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor came back from Xingzhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月丁巳朔，齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year, on dingsi, New Year’s Day; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: New Year’s Day of the eleventh year fell on dingsi; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory missions.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，撒離喝敗吳玠于饒峰關。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Salih defeated Wu Jie at Raofeng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Salih broke Wu Jie at Raofeng Pass.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，取洋州。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Yang Prefecture was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Jin took Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，入興元府。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the army entered Xingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Jin forces marched into Xingyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，元帥府言：「承詔賑軍士，臣恐有司錢幣將不繼。

translations.literal: In the second month on jihai, the Marshal’s Headquarters reported: “We have received an edict to relieve the soldiers; your servant fears the relevant offices’ coin and grain will not suffice.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the second month the Marshal’s Headquarters wrote: “By edict we are to succor the troops; we fear the treasury’s cash and grain will not stretch.

sentences.zh: 請自元帥以下有祿者出錢助給之。

translations.literal: We request that from the Grand Marshal downward all who draw salary contribute money to assist in the grant.”
translations.idiomatic: We ask that every salaried officer from the Grand Marshal down advance funds to help pay it.”

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「官有府庫而取于臣下，此何理耶？

translations.literal: An edict said: “The state has treasuries yet would take from its ministers—what principle is this?
translations.idiomatic: An edict answered: “The throne keeps storehouses and would strip its servants—by what right?

sentences.zh: 其悉從官給。

translations.literal: Let all be supplied entirely from official grants.”
translations.idiomatic: Let every man be paid from the public purse alone.”

sentences.zh: 」八月甲申，黃龍府置錢帛司。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on jiashen, a Coin and Silk Office was established at Huanglong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the eighth month Huanglong Prefecture gained a Coin and Silk Bureau.

sentences.zh: 戊子，趙㮙誣告其父昏德公謀反，㮙及其婿劉文彥伏誅。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Zhao Mao falsely accused his father, the Duke of Hunde, of plotting rebellion; Mao and his son-in-law Liu Wenyan were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhao Mao denounced his father, the Duke of Hunde, for treason; Mao and his son-in-law Liu Wenyan were put to death.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「比以軍旅未定，嘗命帥府自擇人授官，今並從朝廷選注。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict said: “Because campaigns were still unsettled, the Marshal’s Headquarters was once allowed to choose and appoint men on its own; hereafter all appointments shall follow court selection and registration.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict declared: “While war dragged on, the Marshal’s seat could name its own officers; from now every post goes through the central registry.

sentences.zh: 」十月丙申，天清節，齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on bingshen, the Tianqing Festival; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the tenth month, at the Tianqing Festival, Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory embassies.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，賑移懶路。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on bingyin, Yilan Circuit was given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the eleventh month the court relieved Yilan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 宗弼克和尚原。

translations.literal: Zongbi took Heshang Plain.
translations.idiomatic: Zongbi recovered Heshang Plain.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，賑曷懶路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on guiwei, Yilan Circuit was given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the twelfth month Yilan Circuit was relieved again.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月辛亥朔，齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year, on xinhai, New Year’s Day; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: New Year’s Day of the twelfth year fell on xinhai; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory missions.

sentences.zh: 甲子，初改定制度，詔中外。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the institutions were first revised and fixed; an edict announced this within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the dynasty’s institutions were recast for the first time and proclaimed to the court and the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，如東京。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the emperor traveled to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，撒離喝敗宋吳玠軍于固鎮。

translations.literal: In the second month on dingyou, Salih defeated Song general Wu Jie’s army at Guzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the second month Salih routed Song’s Wu Jie at Guzhen.

sentences.zh: 四月，至自東京。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, he returned from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he came back from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，以阿盧補爲元帥右都監。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on jiawu, Alubu was made Marshal Right Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the sixth month Alubu was appointed Right Director of Marshals.

sentences.zh: 十月庚寅，天清節，齊、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on gengyin, the Tianqing Festival; Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the tenth month, at the Tianqing Festival, Qi, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory embassies.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月丙午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year, on bingwu, New Year’s Day; there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: New Year’s Day of the thirteenth year fell on bingwu, and the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上崩于明德宮，年六十一。

translations.literal: On jisi, the emperor died at Mingde Palace, aged sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Taizong died in Mingde Palace, aged sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 庚午，諳班勃極烈即皇帝位于柩前。

translations.literal: On gengwu the an-ban boji lie assumed the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the an-ban boji lie took the throne before the bier.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，上尊諡曰文烈皇帝，廟號太宗。

translations.literal: In the third month on gengchen, the posthumous title Cultured and Ardent Emperor was granted; the temple name Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the third month he was posthumously styled Cultured and Ardent Emperor, temple name Taizong.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，葬和陵。

translations.literal: On yiyou, he was buried at Heling.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he was interred at Heling.

sentences.zh: 皇統四年，改號恭陵。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Huangtong, the tomb name was changed to Gongling.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangtong year four the mausoleum was renamed Gongling.

sentences.zh: 五年，增上尊諡曰體元應運世德昭功哲惠仁聖文烈皇帝。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the posthumous title was further augmented: Embodying the Origin, Answering the Mandate, World Virtue, Illustrious Merit, Wise and Gracious, Benevolent and Sagely, Cultured and Ardent Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In year five his posthumous style was enlarged to Embodying the Origin, Answering the Mandate, World Virtue, Illustrious Merit, Wise and Gracious, Benevolent and Sagely, Cultured and Ardent Emperor.

sentences.zh: 貞元三年十一月戊申，改葬于大房山，仍號恭陵。

translations.literal: On wushen in the eleventh month of the third year of Zhenyuan, he was reburied at Mount Dafang; the tomb was still called Gongling.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the eleventh month of Zhenyuan year three the remains were moved to Mount Dafang, still under the name Gongling.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：天輔草創，未遑禮樂之事。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Under Tianfu the state was newly founded and had no leisure for rites and music.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal runs: In Taizu’s Tianfu reign the realm was still being hammered out—there was no room yet for ritual and music.

sentences.zh: 太宗以斜也、宗幹知國政，以宗翰、宗望總戎事。

translations.literal: Taizong, with Xieye and Zonggan governing the state and Zonghan and Zongwang commanding the armies—
translations.idiomatic: Taizong set Xieye and Zonggan over civil rule and Zonghan and Zongwang over the armies—

sentences.zh: 既滅遼舉宋，即議禮制度，治曆明時，纘以武功，述以文事，經國規摹，至是始定。

translations.literal: —once Liao was destroyed and Song subdued, he at once deliberated ritual institutions, regulated the calendar and clarified the seasons, binding achievement with martial force and ordering it with civil affairs; the blueprint of statecraft was fixed at last.
translations.idiomatic: —and once Liao fell and Song bowed, he turned at once to ritual law, calendar reform, and the ordering of seasons, weaving martial triumph into civil form until the state’s design stood complete.

sentences.zh: 在位十三年，宮室苑舣無所增益。

translations.literal: Thirteen years on the throne, yet palaces, parks, and moored pleasure craft were never increased.
translations.idiomatic: He reigned thirteen years without adding palaces, parks, or pleasure boats.

sentences.zh: 末聽大臣計，傳位熙宗，使太祖世嗣不失正緒，可謂行其所甚難矣！

translations.literal: At the last he heeded his great ministers’ counsel, passed the throne to Xizong, and kept Taizu’s line on the true succession—one may say he did what is hardest of all!
translations.idiomatic: In the end he listened to his chief ministers, handed the throne to Xizong, and preserved Taizu’s house in the right line of succession—he did, one might say, the hardest thing a ruler can do.
